Hey there!

We’re Fever , the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

As Account Development Associate Intern, you will drive the pipeline for our ticketed experiences in the corporate space, generate new revenue opportunities, and lead the full sales cycle for group ticket sales. You will qualify and nurture inbound interest, develop highly targeted outbound strategies, and close ticket sales while refining the commercial methodologies that will fuel your growth (and ours).

· Drive inbound and outbound pipeline for Fever for Business’ corporate ticketing offering.

· Manage and close group ticket sales opportunities, leading the full sales cycle from qualification to payment reception.

· Build and optimize outreach sequences, messaging, and cadences to maximize engagement and conversion.

· Maintain excellent CRM hygiene and ensure accurate forecasting to keep the team aligned on targets.

· Collaborate closely with Billing, with the various Project Managers, and with the Sales team to align campaigns, share insights, and enhance commercial impact.

· Track and report key KPIs (SQLs generated, pipeline value, conversion rates, closed-won revenue) and iterate based on performance data.

· Structured, analytical thinker who defaults to data before forming an opinion

· High attention to detail – CRM hygiene and reporting accuracy depend on it

· Comfort working in spreadsheets and basic BI or reporting tools; Salesforce experience is a strong plus

· Ability to pick up new tools quickly (Clay, Gong, Lead Scouter – you'll use all of them)

· Strong written communication: you'll be producing outputs that go to sales leadership and sometimes to founders

· Self-starter with a bias toward action; comfortable operating without a defined playbook

· Prior exposure to sales ops, revenue ops, business analysis, or structured project work is a plus

· Paid internship

· Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader

· 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences

· Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth

· Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Financial Partnerships team sits within the Global Partnerships organization and is a key component of our success. Our team is responsible for developing and managing relationships with the global and regional banks that enable the Stripe product strategy and deliver new capabilities to Stripe users.

Our team executes on high-impact, cross-functional product partnership initiatives across existing products and early-stage "up the stack" financial products. These partnerships have a significant impact on Stripe and are essential for us to offer products used by millions of our users.

We're looking for a Partner Development Manager to join the Financial Partnerships team. You'll be responsible for developing and executing the multi-year, global strategies for building our relationships across many of our most important banking partners.

You'll focus on designing, scaling, and continuously improving mechanisms to deepen relationships with our partners, as well as highly impactful programs key to differentiating Stripe.

As part of these efforts, you'll collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders (including Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Risk, etc.), and with the banking partners' executive teams.

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated ability to manage and develop partners, think strategically and apply diagnostic thinking to business, product, and technical challenges, and earn trust with and influence others. A high-agency attitude, the ability to raise expectations in changing environments, and a drive to create impact through ownership are all important in this role.

· Develop the go-to-partner strategy and execute on our most ambitious company-bending, bank-network-driven projects that are global and cross-border in nature

· Own the banking partner plans, the overall economics, day-to-day operational excellence, and be responsible for driving the partnerships to successful outcomes for Stripe

· Leverage banking, treasury, and payments industry knowledge to craft thoughtful partnership and product strategies with transaction banks, lenders, capital markets, central banks, and schemes

· Navigate, in partnership with Product, to execute deals supporting that strategy and help ensure a proper execution plan is in place

· Leverage significant industry experience to educate and help internal teams compose our holistic bank-led strategy and to advance that strategy with banking partners

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

· 7+ years of financial services experience, including directly working at banking institutions in cash management, FIG, or payments, and experience in partner management or business development working with banking institutions in PSPs or fintechs enabling pay-in and pay-out, store value, and embedded lending

· Advanced knowledge of the banking and clearing landscape across multiple geographies with specific focus on transaction banking, e-money, safeguarding, multi-currency, and cross-border payments

· Demonstrated experience building proprietary global collection and payout networks

· A proven track record of working in a product-centric environment with significant internal and external dependencies across product, engineering, legal, sales, risk, and compliance

· Broad and deep experience executing industry-wide partnership strategies to build innovative product experiences and go-to-market models
